name: Coins.ph
summary: Philippine regulated crypto and e-money platform that issues PHPC under the BSP Regulatory Sandbox framework described in its official PHPC whitepaper.
notes: The public Coins.ph site states that Betur Inc and DCPay Philippines Inc are BSP-regulated. The exact legal-entity allocation of PHPC issuance within the Coins.ph group remains an explicit review boundary.

name: PT Xfers StraitsX Indonesia
summary: Indonesian StraitsX group entity identified in StraitsX's XIDR launch materials as the issuer of XIDR.
notes: Current StraitsX trust materials list Bank Indonesia Payment Service Provider Category 1 licensing for Indonesian operations and the 2021 launch announcement identifies PT Xfers StraitsX Indonesia as XIDR issuer.
